methodology.inputs: Six StreamingHistory_music files, five Playlist files, YourLibrary.json only.
methodology.counting: Primary analyses use rows with msPlayed >= 30000 and known nonblank artist and title. All-row counts retained for context. 30-second duration is time recorded within a row, not completion or skip probability. Exact duplicate-looking qualifying rows retained because minute precision cannot establish duplication. Track identity is artist + title, not verified recording identity.
methodology.time: Export has minute-resolution end times and no explicit timezone offset. Parsed in UTC only for consistent arithmetic; timezone is not claimed.
methodology.privacy: Only aggregates, monthly/week trajectories, track and artist labels, and music URI examples published. Playlist labels anonymized; no raw event timestamps.
methodology.limits: This is a bounded observation window, not lifetime listening. First observed does not mean discovered. Playlist snapshot is not playlist listening attribution. No audio, mood, lyrical sentiment, or causality inferred from metadata.

rules.traits: Independent steadyPattern (6+ active months and peak share <=35%), returnPattern (28+ day gap), and burstPattern (peak share >=60%) overlap; all require 10+ events. Primary labels retain the explicit precedence below. A steady track can also return after a gap.
rules.return: At least 10 events and an observed gap of at least 28 days between plays.
rules.steady: At least 10 events, activity in at least 6 calendar months, no month over 35% of events, and no return gap.
rules.burst: At least 10 events, 60% or more in one calendar month, and neither return nor steady.
rules.censoring: All histories are left- and right-censored. Boundary flags indicate activity in the first/last export month; even unflagged tracks may have earlier/later listening. Partial boundary months may affect class. First month is first observed, never discovery.

matching.method: Exact case-sensitive artist + title, no normalization or fuzzy matching. URI candidates from playlist and saved-library snapshot, not historical identity proof.

playlists.methodology: One node per exported playlist snapshot entry. Unique Spotify track URIs define sets; duplicate items do not increase overlap. All nonzero-overlap edges retained. Jaccard = intersection / union. Names are anonymized. Snapshot does not show which playlist generated a listening event.

methodology.target: Artist of the next adjacent unambiguous qualifying-play minute group, no more than 30 minutes later. Short or unknown-artist rows are excluded before grouping.
methodology.split: Three expanding-window monthly training folds, nonoverlapping future test periods. Model counts frozen at each cutoff. Recency context updates after each observed minute group.
methodology.frequency: All prior training events ranked by artist frequency.
methodology.recency: Most recently observed unambiguous artists, most recent first; training frequency fallback.
methodology.transition: Training next-artist counts conditional on current artist; training frequency fallback.
methodology.ties: All events with the same minute timestamp form one group. Groups containing multiple artists are ambiguous; exclude transitions into or out of them. Never infer an order within a minute.
methodology.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals are descriptive only; correlated listening events violate independent-trial assumptions. No statistical superiority claim.
methodology.limits: Offline prediction, not causal evidence or a recommendation-quality test. Only qualifying rows of at least 30 seconds with known artists count. Model definitions and thresholds fixed before evaluation; no tuning on any holdout, including final fold. Unseen test artists are retained and count as errors.
